description:
Powerful 1500W Peak Motor with 4 Versatile Modes
Equipped with a 1500W peak motor and a 5-level pedal assist system (PAS), the C300R ST delivers powerful, reliable performance that transforms every ride. At PAS level 1, the motor provides responsive torque for effortless starts; at level 5, top speed reaches 32 MPH—making hills manageable, headwinds lose their sting, and longer routes feel effortlessly within reach. Built with sinusoidal wave structure for smooth operation, low noise, and high temperature resistance, this motor ensures stability across varied terrains with a lifespan exceeding 200,000 hours. A powerful ride, made effortlessly smooth.

Removable 48V 20.8Ah Battery for Flexible Charging & Long Range
Powered by a high-capacity 48V 20.8Ah battery, the C300R ST offers up to 80 miles of range on a single charge, keeping you moving through the week with fewer stops. At Eskute, battery safety is our top priority—each battery pack is certified to meet TÜV safety standards, with advanced thermal protection ensuring zero risk of overheating or thermal runaway. Whether tackling daily commutes or exploring beyond the usual routes, riders can focus on the journey ahead without range anxiety—just consistent, dependable power for effortless travel.

180mm Rear Hydraulic Disc Brake: Dual-System Control
Equipped with a 180mm rear hydraulic disc brake as the centerpiece of its stopping power, complemented by a front disc brake, the C300R ST delivers controlled, predictable braking you can trust. High-performance brake pads achieve the perfect balance between powerful braking and quiet operation—delivering 60% more braking power and reducing stopping distance by 30%. Whether navigating rugged trails or steep descents, you'll experience smooth, progressive engagement without abrupt jolts, making every ride feel safer, more stable, and completely under your control.

Low Step-Through Frame for Easy Mounting & Confident Control
The carbon steel step-through frame is specially designed for easy mounting and dismounting, making it perfect for riders wearing skirts, jeans, or workwear. The low-entry design improves balance at stops and offers a more relaxed, upright riding position that enhances visibility and control in city traffic.

Front headlight with two high-intensity LED bulbs offers 30% more brightness for clear visibility in low-light conditions. The rear red LED illuminates when braking, serving as a clear warning signal for safer night rides and traffic. Together, they ensure you stay seen and stay safe—whether riding at dawn, dusk, or after dark.

The left-mounted LCD display clearly shows essential riding data such as speed, battery level, distance, and assist mode at a glance. Quickly wake your display with a simple NFC tap for effortless riding—no fumbling for keys or buttons. This intuitive interface keeps you informed and in control, so you can focus on the road ahead.

The Shimano 8-speed drivetrain delivers precise gear changes for optimal pedaling efficiency. Whether tackling steep inclines or maintaining momentum, it offers smooth, responsive control—letting you enjoy traditional riding or electric-assisted power in every gear. From technical climbs to flat-out cruising, the drivetrain adapts seamlessly to your riding style and terrain.
